column1: # OWASP ZAP rule configuration, read by scripts/security/dast.sh
# Rules not listed use their default (WARN). FAIL breaks the build.
# Injection: a hit here is a real, exploitable vulnerability.
# 40014 (persistent XSS) is WARN, not FAIL: ZAP stores "<script>" in a
# note and gets it back inside JSON. This API only returns JSON, with
# nosniff and a CSP, so it is not exploitable here; a frontend must still
# escape note content when rendering it. Packaged scans cannot target the
# JSON-only variant (40014-2), so the whole rule is downgraded and stays
# visible as a warning. Revisit if the API ever returns HTML.
